properties.headline: High Wind Watch issued November 16 at 3:53PM MST until November 18 at 2:00PM MST by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...West winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 70-75 mph possible.

* WHERE...Rocky Mountain National Park and the Medicine Bow Range.

* WHEN...From late Tuesday night through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds could blow down trees and power lines.
Widespread power outages are possible. Travel could be difficult,
especially for high profile vehicles.
properties.areaDesc: South and East Jackson/Larimer/North and Northeast Grand/Northwest Boulder Counties Above 9000 Feet

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 16 at 11:25AM MST until November 17 at 10:00PM MST by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...In Colorado, Four Corners/Upper Dolores River and Paradox
Valley/Lower Dolores River. In Utah, Arches/Grand Flat and
Southeast Utah.

* WHEN...From 10 AM to 10 PM MST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
properties.areaDesc: Paradox Valley/Lower Dolores River; Four Corners/Upper Dolores River; Southeast Utah; Arches/Grand Flat
